label: Version 1.3.6
releaseNotes: Uses all 1,573 rows and all 14 columns from the approved station workbook as the structured station source.
Adds one optional Stations selector that searches station key, station ID, VISN, station name, and parent station ID.
Applies the selected station_id to referral data while keeping rows without a station_id visible but unavailable for selection.
Makes the optional blank choices for SEOC Number and SEOC ID explicit in the interface.
